ideas.title: The $3.7 Billion Surplus and the Test of Minnesota’s Governing Character
ideas.description: Investigate how Minnesota's $3.7 billion surplus could be impacted by fraud and corruption in the state's Medicaid program.
questions: How much of the surplus is at risk due to fraud?
What steps is the state taking to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: The surplus provides a critical opportunity to investigate how Minnesota is addressing fraud and corruption in its Medicaid program.

ideas.title: Minnesota Sues Trump Administration Over Withheld Medicaid Funds
ideas.description: Investigate the lawsuit filed by Minnesota against the Trump administration over withheld Medicaid funds.
questions: What are the implications of the lawsuit for Minnesota's Medicaid program?
How much are the withheld funds?
ideas.insight: The lawsuit provides a critical opportunity to analyze the impact of the withheld funds on Minnesota's Medicaid program.
